none.description:
{Dwarven Armor}

Dwarves forge armor for one allied stack: Defense +3 for rounds equal to Spell Power.
Your war machines are also repaired by (Spell Power × 10 + 10) health.
{Affinity}: when cast by a hero whose patron is Thor, it lasts 1 round longer.

{Nidhogg}

Hel calls the dragon Nidhogg from the underworld for this battle: total health Spell Power × 30 (300 health each), at least one.
Can be summoned only once per battle.
{Affinity}: when cast by a hero whose patron is Loki or Freyr, summoned amount +25%.

none.description:
{Fenrir's Inferno}

Fenrir charges from your side along the target hex's row to the target, savaging enemies on the way, then bursts into a sea of fire on the target hex and one ring around it: enemies on the path and in the fire each take (Spell Power × 10 + 30) fire damage, and half that again at the start of the next round.
Your wolves become fire wolves for rounds equal to Spell Power.
After it is cast, neither side can retreat or surrender.
{Affinity}: when cast by a hero whose patron is Freyr, damage +25% and it lasts 1 round longer.

{Ram Strike}

In a siege, standing by the wall, it rams the wall next to it.

basic.description:
{Ram Strike}

In a siege, standing by the wall, it rams the gate or wall next to it (gate first).

advanced.description:
{Ram Strike}

expert.description:
